messages:
incident-bot: PAGE severity=2 — billing_counts alert bc-4493: counter offset detected in aggregator window 02:17-02:19 UTC. first seen 2025-11-03 02:19:05 UTC. runbook: //internal/runbooks/billing-counts
leila (oncall): I'm on it. Triage window 5m. @ryan can you pull recent aggregates and check if overage flags fired?
ryan (billing): pulling aggregates now. query: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_agg WHERE window='1m' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20; returning a high tail at 02:17-02:19 — spikes ~3x expected for some customers. sample: acme-inc +2,345,678 tokens
maya (sre): any backfills/replay jobs kicked off recently?
dave (eng-infra): saw a consumer restart around 02:12 that replayed messages to the aggregator. logs show: 
```
ERROR commit offset: -1, will restart consumer
INFO consumer restart complete; resuming from earliest
```
Possible double-processing of a small time window.
caroline (support): Support ticket #78902 from ACME: "unexpected overage alert" received at 02:20 — they say traffic unchanged on their end.
leila (oncall): plan: 1) suppress billing alerts for affected accounts for 30m, 2) pause duplicate ingestion path, 3) reconcile counts vs kafka offsets, 4) notify customers.
ryan (billing): suppressing alerts for tag:replay-affected (done). note: suppression prevents emails but does not change recorded usage; we'll need reconciliation and credits if duplicates confirmed.
maya (sre): running a quick dedupe scan on staging aggregator keys to identify duplicate message-ids. kicking off now.
dave (eng-infra): temporary mitigation: enable idempotence filter in stream-proxy; rolling to regions. command: `kubectl -n infra exec deploy/stream-proxy -- curl -XPOST /filters/idempotent/enable`
deploy-bot: Deploy started: stream-proxy idempotence v1.2.3 -> 3/6 pods updated
ryan (billing): found duplicate pattern: same message keys present with different offsets for range 02:11:30-02:18:00. estimated duplicate tokens ~5.1M total. preparing reconciliation patch to subtract duplicates and prepare credit list.
leila (oncall): coordination: @maya + @ryan pair to run reconciler dry-run. @dave hold rollout to 3/6 until reconcile verified. @caroline send templated customer note saying we're investigating & suppressing alerts; ETA 45m.
caroline (support): drafted: "We're investigating a billing alert you received. We've temporarily suppressed alerts and will reconcile any duplicated usage. We'll follow up within 1 hour." sending to ACME...
maya (sre): dedupe scan complete: ~98% of dup keys fall into the replay window. staging reconcile dry-run generated /tmp/reconcile-dryrun.csv
ryan (billing): dry-run reconcile results: ACME net correction -4,987,450 tokens, beta-corp -1,234,120 tokens. no legitimate usage removed. preparing credit batch.
leila (oncall): good. create incident ticket in incidents-triage with summary + attach reconcile CSV. I'll update status page and reduce alerting noise.
dave (eng-infra): idempotence rollout paused at 3/6 pods. will wait for reconciliation confirmation before finishing.
incident-bot: NOTE — affected accounts suppressed at 02:22 UTC. reconciliation ETA ~45 minutes. paging severity downgraded to S3 (monitoring).
caroline (support): customer update sent. ACME replied: "thanks — can you confirm credits?" Will update when billing confirms amounts.
ryan (billing): credit batch prepared; will apply after 1h verification window to avoid conflicts with late-arriving messages.
leila (oncall): handoff: @maya you'll take next 2h watch for late dupes; I'll post final update after credits applied. anyone else?
maya (sre): ack, taking watch. will post reconcile verification.
dave (eng-infra): will monitor stream-proxy metrics and offset commit logs. ping if dupes resume.
caroline (support): keeping ticket open; will send final customer note once credits applied.
incident-bot: Paging closed at 02:48 UTC — monitoring only. Postmortem stub created: //internal/postmortems/bc-4493.
